identity.name: ScienceDirect
identity.description: Elsevier's journal and book platform (Energy and Buildings, Energy Policy, Applied Energy, Energy Research & Social Science, The Electricity Journal …), reached programmatically through the Elsevier Article Retrieval and Object Retrieval APIs.

asserted.rationale: Publisher of record for a large share of the building-energy and energy-policy literature the pilot needs; the Article Retrieval API returns the version of record itself. Peer review is the journals'; tier 1 is for the article of record, not an endorsement of every paper's claims.

jurisdiction.notes: Global literature; the pilot filters to US single-family housing at query time.

artifacts.notes: Article Retrieval: full-text-retrieval-response (coredata + originalText) when the key/insttoken is entitled; metadata/abstract otherwise.
Object Retrieval: article objects, often including AAM-PDF (accepted author manuscript).

content.notes: The website's PDF route is bot-walled (Cloudflare) even with entitlement; the APIs are the sanctioned programmatic route.

auth.notes: Key in header X-ELS-APIKey (credential_ref elsevier_api_key). Full text additionally needs entitlement: a campus IP or an institutional token in header X-ELS-Insttoken (credential_ref elsevier_insttoken). The reference CLI injects only ONE credential per method, so the insttoken cannot be sent by `authority fetch` today (see ext.hermes).

limits.notes: Elsevier sets per-key quotas and throttles (typically on the order of 10 req/s with a weekly cap for Article Retrieval); read X-RateLimit-* headers and the key's settings page. Not independently verified.

robots.tos_notes: Use is governed by the Elsevier API Service Agreement and, for TDM, the institution's licence.

endpoints.name: article-by-doi
endpoints.description: Retrieve an article by DOI (full text when entitled).

params.name: doi
params.description: Elsevier DOI (10.1016/…). The CLI URL-encodes the slash.

params.name: http_accept
params.description: text/xml (default, full-text XML) or application/json; text/plain for plain text.

params.name: view
params.description: META, META_ABS, META_ABS_REF, FULL (FULL needs entitlement).

response.notes: full-text-retrieval-response; coredata carries dc:title, prism:doi, openaccess flags; originalText only when entitled.

endpoints.name: article-by-pii
endpoints.description: Retrieve an article by ScienceDirect PII (no slash, so no path-encoding question).

params.name: pii
params.description: ScienceDirect PII (e.g. S0301421525002198; Crossref alternative-id carries it).

verification.notes: Probed 2026-09-27 with this machine's self-service key from a non-campus egress: HTTP 403 even for view=META on a gold-OA article, so the key is not provisioned for Article Retrieval (matches pdf-harvest's 2026-09-08 finding). The derived state is therefore blocked; re-probe after the library issues an insttoken or the key gains Article Retrieval, or from a campus/VPN egress.

auth.notes: Same key as article-api. Verified 2026-09-27 with the self-service key. Self-service keys usually reach Object Retrieval even when Article Retrieval full text is refused (pdf-harvest uc-davis-route.md, measured 2026-09-08).

limits.notes: Per-key quotas as for article-api; not independently verified.

endpoints.name: objects-by-doi
endpoints.description: List an article's retrievable objects (figures, supplementary files, and often AAM-PDF, the accepted author manuscript).

response.notes: Answers HTTP 300 Multiple Choices with {choices:{choice:[{@ref, @type, $}]}}; $ is the object URL (fetch with the same key header). @type values seen: IMAGE-DOWNSAMPLED, IMAGE-THUMBNAIL, IMAGE-HIGH-RES, ALTIMG; an AAM appears as a type containing 'AAM' (pdf-harvest fetch_elsevier_api.py). The 2026-09-27 probe DOI (a gold-OA article) listed 51 image objects and no AAM.

best_for: Version-of-record text of Elsevier papers (Energy and Buildings, Energy Policy, Applied Energy, ERSS …) when the key or campus IP is entitled
Accepted author manuscripts (AAM-PDF) via Object Retrieval when full text is not entitled
Quoting findings, figures and numbers from Elsevier articles into a UPC corpus

query_shapes.recipe: view=FULL from a UC Davis campus/VPN egress, or with an insttoken (not injectable by the CLI yet). Check originalText is present; absence = not entitled.

List objects; if a choice whose @type contains AAM exists, fetch its $ URL with the same key header (outside the CLI: the object URL is not a declared endpoint); record version=acceptedVersion in UPC.

pitfalls: 'AUTHENTICATION_ERROR — Requestor configuration settings insufficient' means the key is not provisioned for that API (or not entitled), not that the key is wrong.
A 200 response without originalText is metadata only: the key/IP is not entitled to full text for that item.
AAMs are post-peer-review but not the typeset version: never cite page numbers from them as the journal's.
Never scrape www.sciencedirect.com PDF routes (Cloudflare-gated against automation even with entitlement); use these APIs or a human click (pdf-harvest assisted mode).
Bulk full-text pulls need a TDM entitlement: ask the UC Davis library for an insttoken rather than looping on campus IP.
guidance.llm_notes: Use only for DOIs with prefix 10.1016 (and other Elsevier prefixes). Try Unpaywall first; come here for the version of record or when no OA copy exists.

resolution.notes: Publisher of record for its own journals.

lifecycle.cadence_notes: Articles published continuously; API versions change rarely.

relations.notes: One of the core journals for the pilot; others include Energy Policy, Applied Energy and Energy Research & Social Science.

discovery.discovered_via: model knowledge (Hermes scholarly registry pass), cross-checked against pdf-harvest references

optional_credentials.notes: Institutional token from UC Davis Library; the reference CLI cannot inject a second credential, so a Hermes script must add this header itself if Ellie obtains one.

officiality.basis: The publisher's platform for its own journals' versions of record.
officiality.notes: AAMs from Object Retrieval are author versions, not the version of record.

completeness.notes: Exhaustive for Elsevier's own journals only.
